FluxProV1EraseInput.description:
Input for the FLUX Erase endpoint.

FLUX Erase removes content from images using a black/white mask.

dilate_pixels.description: Number of pixels to expand the mask edges by. Higher values produce cleaner erase results around the masked region.
dilate_pixels.title: Dilate Pixels

image_url.description: The URL of the input image to erase content from.
image_url.title: Image URL

mask_url.description: The URL of a black/white mask image where white (255) marks pixels to erase and black (0) marks pixels to keep. Needs to match the dimensions of the input image.
mask_url.title: Mask URL

output_format.description: The format of the generated image.
output_format.title: Output Format

sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

FluxProV1EraseInput.title: FluxProEraseInput

has_nsfw_concepts.description: Whether the generated images contain NSFW concepts.
has_nsfw_concepts.title: Has Nsfw Concepts

prompt.description: The prompt used for generating the image.
prompt.title: Prompt

seed.description:
Seed of the generated Image. It will be the same value of the one passed in the
            input or the randomly generated that was used in case none was passed.
seed.title: Seed
